name: Hidden Path
summary: In Durotar, the Hidden Path climbs above the Valley of Trials toward Spirit Rock. Young shaman follow it to prove their awareness and discipline, while its high reaches look west toward the Barrens.

sections.title: A Sacred Ascent
sections.body: The Hidden Path climbs through red peaks above the Valley of Trials, hard to spot from the canyon floor. Mentors send young shaman along it to test their awareness and discipline before they commune with the spirits at Spirit Rock. From the highest reaches, you can see west across the rolling savannas of the Barrens.

sections.title: Strategic Vulnerability
sections.body: The Hidden Path also cuts through the natural defenses around the valley. A low pass leads toward Ratchet and the road to Orgrimmar. It bypasses the usual canyon checkpoints, leaving defenders wary that Alliance infiltrators could use the quiet trail to reach the Horde's proving grounds.

faq.q: Where does the Hidden Path lead?
faq.answer: The Hidden Path climbs from the Valley of Trials into the crags and reaches Spirit Rock, where shaman commune with the elements. Its mountain passes also connect toward the Barrens and the coastline.

faq.q: Why is the path significant to shaman?
faq.answer: Young shaman in the Valley of Trials seek the Hidden Path as part of their early elemental trials. The climb leads to Spirit Rock, where they drink Sapta to commune with the spirits.

faq.q: Could enemies use the Hidden Path to attack the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: Yes. Low gaps along the Hidden Path bypass the valley's usual guarded entrances. An Alliance strike force coming from Ratchet or the coast could use the trail to slip past Horde scouts and enter the training grounds unseen.

faq.q: What can you see from the top of the path?
faq.answer: From the Hidden Path's highest point, you can look west over the Barrens and across the red canyons of Durotar.

angles.text: As a shaman, you make your first true physical and spiritual climb on the Hidden Path. It tests your perception before you commune with the earth spirits at Spirit Rock.
Though sacred to shaman, the Hidden Path is an unfortified passage above the Valley of Trials. It leaves a blind spot that calls for a watchful eye.
